title: A Final Farewell…And Promise
front_description: The twin suns of Tatooine beat down on Cliegg Lars and his loved ones as they pay their final respects to Shmi. Silent and deeply heart-broken, Anakin steps forward and kneels at his mother's grave. "I wasn't strong enough to save you, Mom," he says grimly, picking up a handful of sand. "I wasn't strong enough. But I promise I won't fail again?
back_description: George Lucas directs Anthony Daniels (C-3PO) on location at the Lars homestead.
